author: fidjissimo
text: So glad that @SummerDashe is putting the spotlight on POTS. Like Summer, I never had COVID but have been living with POTS for a year, and I have hope that the pandemic will bring awareness to this horrible condition.

quoted.text: Many #COVID19 patients are developing POTS. I never had COVID, but I’ve been living with #POTS for 4 years. In a special report on @6News at 6 Tuesday night, we’re looking into the latest research linking COVID and POTS and what doctors know now. #WATE #longhaulers @Dysautonomia https://t.co/JGNHjKo2QR

author: fidjissimo
text: @shannern Thanks so much for sharing parts of my talk! ❤️

“When I started showing the cracks, that my life was not perfect, but that I could live through it, it helped people who were going through difficult situations, because we’re all going through stuff. It helps them build a deeper relationship with me.” @fidjissimo #DysConf2020

“I refuse to accept that we’re going to feel like this our entire lives, so we just have to find a cure [for #dysautonomia. I haven’t met a woman that isn’t strong, so let’s get it done.” -@fidjissimo #DysConf2020

The fabulous @fidjissimo's advice on helping children understand a parent having dysautonomia is to teach them to listen to their body and what THEIR body is telling them. “We need to listen to all of the wisdom that the body holds.” #dysconf2020

author: fidjissimo
text: @SummerDashe @Dysautonomia Summer, it means so much coming from you! Your story inspired me so much when I first got diagnosed! Thanks for all you've done! We should connect :)
